request_user:
Fact: eval_methodology
What to find: How evaluations were run (harness, settings, prompts, shots).
Card sections that often contain it: Evaluation, Methodology

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Only partial methodology is given: test-time scaling (TTS) results on a few benchmarks were evaluated via DeepConf, and AMO-Bench* is limited to the parser-verifiable subset of 39 problems. Recommended sampling settings are temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, max new tokens up to 65536. The card does not state the evaluation harness, prompts or shots for the main benchmark table, and refers to the technical report for training details.
quotes: TTS represents test time scaling results on few of the benchmarks that we evaluated via [DeepConf](https://github.com/facebookresearch/deepconf). Note that AMO-Bench* is limited to the parser-verifiable subset which comprises 39 problems.
We recommend using a **temperature** of **0.6** and **top-p** as **0.95** with max new tokens up to 65536.
